numberingPolicy: Game numbers are global collection slots. Hall order does not force a numeric range; each hall can hold 11 official game concepts.
slotVariantRunPolicy: The 99 game slots represent 99 game concepts, not 99 AI generations. A single game may contain multiple model variants and run records. Model comparisons are stored as variants/runs under the same game slot and do not consume additional game numbers.

halls.name: Arcade Reaction Hall
halls.description: Fast reaction games, dodging, jumping, score chasing, and short-loop arcade games.

halls.name: Puzzle Logic Hall
halls.description: Puzzles, logic gates, mazes, sequencing, deduction, and constrained movement.

halls.name: Survival Strategy Hall
halls.description: Survival loops, resource pressure, route planning, hostile environments, and tactical movement.

halls.name: Card Strategy Hall
halls.description: Card games, dice games, turn-based battles, drafting, and roguelite decision systems.

halls.name: Text Adventure Hall
halls.description: Interactive fiction, branching stories, terminal games, AI-themed stories, and RPG-style text systems.

halls.name: Clicker Management Hall
halls.description: Incremental games, business sims, resource management, and automation loops.

halls.name: Physics Experiment Hall
halls.description: Physics toys, gravity games, projectile games, magnets, bouncing, and sandbox mechanics.

halls.name: Rhythm Audio Hall
halls.description: Rhythm games, music memory, beat timing, and audio-reactive games.

halls.name: AI Meme Hall
halls.description: AI jokes, agent failures, prompt chaos, token bills, model battles, and weird AI behavior games.
